proposals.quote: be preceded by an individual notice and appropriate warning to the Subscriber
proposals.rationale: No warning has been sent (warning_sent is false), so suspending now would skip the advance notice that 22.1.1 requires. The unpaid invoice is for the mobile line only, so any interruption must be limited to that service as far as technically feasible (22.1.2). That rules out suspending home broadband. The warning must state the actions needed, the due dates and the consequences (22.2), and emergency numbers must stay reachable (22.4). Contract term 14.2, which allows suspension without prior notice, does not replace these requirements.

reasoning_chain: Do not suspend all services on the account. The rule's proposal conflicts with 22.1.1 (no warning sent) and 22.1.2 (broadband is not the unpaid service).
The subscriber's claimed payment of 2026-10-14 is not matched to the account. Billing should check it before any suspension.
Subscriber language preference is unknown, so the draft is in English. Offer another language if requested.
The clauses do not state the length of the warning period, so the dunning owner must set the suspension date.
